name: blast-radius-calibration
description: Calibration eval for judge-blast-radius. Runs blast-radius-classify against the labeled blast-radius-calibration dataset and scores the emitted radius EXACTLY against the human label. Pass rate = scoping accuracy; the per-row drilldown shows exactly which changes the judge mis-scopes (and in which direction — under-scoping misses regressions, over-scoping wastes the QA budget), which is what you tune the rubric against. Run it from the Evals page, or replay the dataset through /api/runs/start.
